import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime for analysis
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Top left: Total Sales by Product
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors[:len(product_sales)])
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Add value labels
for bar, val in zip(bars1, product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Top right: Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors[:len(age_sales)],
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(age_sales), startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.setp(autotexts, size=9, weight='bold')

# 3. Bottom left: Average Order Value by Size and Payment Method
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='size', columns='payment_method', 
                            aggfunc='mean').reindex(size_order)
pivot_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=colors[:len(pivot_data.columns)], width=0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Order Value ($)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Order Value by Size & Payment Method', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Payment Method', fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax3.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=10)

# 4. Bottom right: Dine-in vs Takeaway Analysis by Product
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
takeaway_data = df.groupby(['product', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
takeaway_data.columns = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
takeaway_data = takeaway_data.sort_values('Takeaway', ascending=True)

x = range(len(takeaway_data))
width = 0.35
bars_dinein = ax4.barh([i - width/2 for i in x], takeaway_data['Dine-in'], 
                        width, label='Dine-in', color=colors[0])
bars_takeaway = ax4.barh([i + width/2 for i in x], takeaway_data['Takeaway'], 
                          width, label='Takeaway', color=colors[3])

ax4.set_yticks(x)
ax4.set_yticklabels(takeaway_data.index)
ax4.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Dine-in vs Takeaway Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(fontsize=10)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
